jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
HI! WE'RE FORERUNNER.

Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.

Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the ongoing success of a full book of business — from onboarding through renewal — ensuring every account realizes measurable value from Forerunner and grows into a durable, trusted partnership. You'll work at the intersection of relationship management, product adoption, and account growth, partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering to keep outcomes on track.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


CUSTOMER HEALTH & RETENTION

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to your accounts, understanding their workflows and goals well enough to guide them toward renewal.

 - Own customer health across your portfolio, using data and regular check-ins to catch risk early and keep accounts moving toward measurable outcomes.

 - Guide customers through public-sector and regulated-industry decision cycles with patience and clear communication.


PRODUCT ADOPTION

 - Partner with the Deployment Specialist to take a clean handoff at go-live and carry momentum into the ongoing success phase.

 - Drive adoption through user communications, customized in-app onboarding, and continued learning so customers get full value from their investment.

 - Configure customer environments and settings as needs evolve, using both the product front end and Forerunner's internal tools.


ACCOUNT GROWTH

 - Identify and pursue expansion opportunities — upsells, add-ons, and cross-sells — within your accounts.

 - Partner with Sales and leadership to build the case for expansion and drive it to close.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP

 - Share customer feedback, ideas, and concerns with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

 - Evangelize customer success stories across your accounts to help build the broader Forerunner community.


TEAM BUILDING

 - Contribute to the ongoing development of CS policy, process, and playbooks as an early member of a growing team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4-6 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or client services, with a track record of managing end-to-end renewals and proactively uncovering expansion opportunities within a portfolio.

 - Experience serving government agencies or regulated industries — GovTech, floodplain management or flood insurance, GIS/mapping, or public-sector project management are all relevant backgrounds, though not required.

 - Comfortable managing complex, public-sector relationships and decision cycles; experience partnering with government clients or supporting complex public-sector workflows is a plus.

 - An excellent, empathetic communicator — you're often a customer's first point of contact, and building trust matters in our space.

 - Detail-oriented and committed to quality, with genuine enthusiasm for creating customer value.

 - Comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity — able to prioritize independently and take on responsibility as the team grows.

 - Experience supporting SaaS software is preferred but not required.


YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU...

 - Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.

 - Enjoy being a trusted point of contact and building long-term relationships.

 - Are comfortable balancing day-to-day account management with longer-term account strategy.


OUR TEAM HAS A LOT TO OFFER.

Forerunner is an early-stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

 - We're mission-driven. Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We're in the weeds — our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real-world problems they face.

 - We're a small team. As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.

 - We build each other up. A team works best when its members are equipped with the tools to tackle the problems they're facing. Forerunner strives to provide meaningful feedback and learning opportunities to help all our team members grow.

 - We value in-person collaboration. Some of our best work happens when we're solving problems together in the same room, so this role is hybrid and based near one of our offices: New York City, San Francisco, or Portland, Maine.

 - We want you to be happy and healthy. Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, a 401k plan, and one expensed lunch per week. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so you can define what "health" means to you.

 - The salary range for this position is $105,000-$125,000 with an OTE of $125,000-$145,000. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.



Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales
jobs.description:
HI! WE'RE FORERUNNER.

Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.

Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.




ABOUT THE POSITION

We are seeking a Vice President of Sales to lead and scale our new business organization at a pivotal stage of growth.

Reporting to the CEO, this leader will own the strategy, performance, and long-term vision of the Sales organization. You will shape how Forerunner wins new customers across the public sector and regulated industries, building a predictable revenue engine while opening new markets for our platform.

This role sits at the intersection of revenue, product, and market strategy. You will bring executive-level leadership to a team of Account Executives and a BDR organization, elevate forecasting and operational rigor, and drive alignment across Customer Success, Marketing, and Product.

As we scale, Sales must turn a proven public-sector motion into a predictable growth engine while opening new markets in regulated industries. You will lead both.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy and also stay in the work: running deals, building processes, and selling alongside your team.

This is a hybrid role based out of one of our talent hubs in New York City, San Francisco, or Portland, Maine.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


REVENUE STRATEGY & GROWTH

 - Define and execute the long-term sales strategy in partnership with the CEO and executive team

 - Own new business bookings, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy

 - Scale our public-sector business across every level of government, from local communities to federal agencies

 - Lead expansion into regulated private-sector industries, shaping how Forerunner sells to new buyer types


ORGANIZATIONAL LEADERSHIP

 - Lead and develop a growing team of Account Executives and Business Development Representatives

 - Establish clear performance standards, territory and segment strategies, and operating rhythms

 - Recruit and develop high-performing sellers, and build a culture that is mission-driven, motivating, and results-oriented

 - Scale leadership capacity within the team


SALES PROCESS & OPERATIONAL RIGOR

 - Build the systems, stages, and reporting that create predictability at scale

 - Partner with Operations to mature our pricing, packaging, and deal structure

 - Guide the team through public-sector procurement and long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles

 - Stay close to the work by joining calls, coaching live deals, and personally driving key opportunities to close


EXECUTIVE CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ALIGNMENT

 - Serve as the executive voice of the market across the company

 - Partner with Customer Success to ensure strong handoffs, expansion, and long-term account planning

 - Partner with Marketing to build a sustainable pipeline generation strategy across segments

 - Influence Product through clear articulation of market needs and competitive dynamics




ABOUT YOU

You are an experienced sales leader who has built and scaled new business teams in high-growth B2B SaaS environments.

You bring a strategic perspective and a bias toward action. You can design a sales engine that drives predictability while staying close enough to deals and sellers to understand nuance.

You likely bring:

 - Significant experience leading B2B SaaS sales teams, including managing managers

 - A track record of scaling teams, building repeatable sales processes, and forecasting with accuracy

 - Experience selling to complex, regulated buyers (GovTech experience is a plus, but adjacent sectors such as infrastructure, energy, or construction are also relevant)

 - Experience opening a new market, segment, or buyer type

 - Strong executive presence and cross-functional influence

 - Early-stage experience, comfort in the undefined, and a willingness to do the work yourself, from prospecting to building a process from scratch

 - A leadership style that balances accountability with warmth and partnership




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within the first year, you will have:

 - Built Sales into a predictable, performance-driven function with reliable forecasting

 - Grown new business bookings and pipeline in our core public-sector market

 - Established a repeatable motion for selling into regulated private-sector industries

 - Strengthened the AE and BDR teams through hiring, coaching, and clear standards

 - Created tight alignment with Customer Success and Marketing across the customer lifecycle




OUR TEAM HAS A LOT TO OFFER

Forerunner is an early-stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

 - We're mission-driven. Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We’re in the weeds - our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real-world problems they face.

 - We're a small team. As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.

 - We build each other up. A team works best when its members are adequately equipped with the tools to tackle the problems they are facing. Forerunner strives to provide adequate feedback and appropriate learning opportunities to help all its team members expand their skills.

 - We value in-person collaboration. Some of our best work happens when we're solving problems together in the same room, so this role is hybrid and based near one of our offices: New York City, San Francisco, or Portland, Maine.

 - We want you to be happy and healthy. Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, a 401k plan, and one expensed lunch per week. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so that you can have flexibility in defining what “health” means to you.

The salary range for this position is $210,000- $250,000 with an OTE $310,000-$400,000.  This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual’s skills, experience, and qualifications.
